question: What’s the closest restaurant as you travel from Funkmeyer New Reality Garden, Los Angeles, CA toward Warner Bros. Transportation Museum, Burbank, CA?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-118.366951 34.039786)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-118.340304 34.14642)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'restaurant'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-118.366951 34.039786)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-118.366951 34.039786)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

[2].display_name: Funkmeyer New Reality Garden, Los Angeles, CA

[3].display_name: Warner Bros. Transportation Museum, Burbank, CA

poi.description: Warner Bros. houses some amazing film vehicles including a Batmobile, the Ford from Harry Potter and the Mach 5.
